verdict.rationale: Meltano documents incremental replication state tracking so that a pipeline resumes from the last bookmark on subsequent runs (meltano-docs-20, meltano-docs-30), which covers the 'resume from checkpoint' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of automatic retry logic for transient failures (network blips, API rate limits) or of mid-sync failure recovery beyond state-based incremental restarts. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry/backoff on transient errors, evidence of resuming a sync that was interrupted mid-run (not just re-running with prior state), and any monitoring/alerting tie-in to retries.
